name: Scrappy
title: scrappy.jrcpl.us
shortDescription: Scrappy is a desktop-only research prototype designed to facilitate dynamic document creation. It is ideal for users needing to manage events, perform basic calculations, or track time-sensitive financial data. For example, event organizers can use Scrappy to monitor attendance and manage schedules efficiently.
pros: Includes templates for various use cases
cons: No mobile or web version available
